verdict.rationale: Meltano provides the Singer SDK for building taps/targets and an EDK for Meltano Components, with community testimony confirming a positive hands-on experience building a custom tap. However, this is not an 'AI-native' SDK (no LLM/agent-specific API, no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt found by probes), so it only partially satisfies an AI-native builder's expectations. missing for 10: AI-native/LLM-oriented SDK or API surface, OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404s), llms.txt discoverability (404), independent AI-agent usage examples.
